'''Nevar Yalnal''' was a [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] from [[Aralia/Legends|Aralia]]. He slyly spied for the people with the most [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. He was an outcast who worked as a laborer for the [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] trader [[Hrchek Kal Fas/Legends|Hrchek Kal Fas]].<ref name="CCG" />
